title: DSPy Datasets Module
summary: This module provides tools for loading, managing, and splitting datasets for DSPy programs. It includes utilities for importing data from various sources and specialized datasets like AlfWorld, GSM8K, and MATH.

nodes.label: Load Data from Various Sources
nodes.title: Data Loader
nodes.description: Provides methods to load datasets from Hugging Face, CSV, JSON, Parquet, pandas DataFrames, and DSPy Retrieval Modules, converting them into DSPy Example objects.

nodes.label: Manage Dataset Splits & Sampling
nodes.title: Base Dataset Manager
nodes.description: Base class for DSPy datasets, offering functionalities for shuffling, sampling, and splitting data into train, dev, and test sets based on configurable seeds and sizes.

nodes.label: AlfWorld Environment Dataset
nodes.title: AlfWorld Dataset
nodes.description: Manages the AlfWorld interactive environment dataset, providing access to training and development examples for agent interaction tasks.

nodes.label: AlfWorld Environment Worker
nodes.title: AlfWorld Worker
nodes.description: A worker process that manages a single AlfredTWEnv instance for AlfWorld, handling environment initialization and step actions.

nodes.label: GSM8K Math Word Problems
nodes.title: GSM8K Dataset
nodes.description: Loads and preprocesses the GSM8K dataset, extracting questions, gold reasoning, and answers into DSPy Example objects for mathematical reasoning tasks.

nodes.label: MATH Reasoning Dataset
nodes.title: MATH Dataset
nodes.description: Loads and preprocesses the MATH dataset for mathematical reasoning, extracting problems, solutions, and answers into DSPy Example objects.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Datasets Hub
nodes.title: Hugging Face Datasets
nodes.description: An external platform providing a vast collection of datasets, used as a source for `DataLoader`, `GSM8K`, and `MATH`.

nodes.label: CSV Data File
nodes.title: CSV File
nodes.description: An external CSV file used as a data source by the `DataLoader`.

nodes.label: JSON Data File
nodes.title: JSON File
nodes.description: An external JSON file used as a data source by the `DataLoader`.

nodes.label: Parquet Data File
nodes.title: Parquet File
nodes.description: An external Parquet file used as a data source by the `DataLoader`.

nodes.label: Pandas DataFrame
nodes.title: Pandas DataFrame
nodes.description: An in-memory pandas DataFrame used as a data source by the `DataLoader`.

nodes.label: DSPy Retrieval Module
nodes.title: DSPy Retrieval Module
nodes.description: An external DSPy Retrieval Module configured via `dspy.settings.rm`, used by `DataLoader` to fetch examples.

nodes.label: DSPy Example Object
nodes.title: DSPy Example
nodes.description: The standard data structure in DSPy for representing individual data points, typically containing inputs and labels.

groups.label: File-based Data Sources
groups.title: File-based Data Sources
groups.description: External file formats from which data can be loaded into DSPy.

groups.label: Programmatic Data Sources
groups.title: Programmatic Data Sources
groups.description: External or in-memory data sources accessed programmatically by DSPy components.

groups.label: Dataset Loaders
groups.title: Dataset Loaders
groups.description: Components responsible for loading and initial processing of various datasets into DSPy's internal format.

groups.label: Dataset Management & Utilities
groups.title: Dataset Management & Utilities
groups.description: Core components for managing dataset properties, splits, and specific environment interactions.

groups.label: DSPy Data Structure
groups.title: DSPy Data Structure
groups.description: The fundamental data unit used across DSPy programs for representing individual data points.
